title: Unapochagua kliniki ya afya ya akili, huenda iliyo na madaktari wengi ikawa bora

text.Now, I make sure to go to a mental healt: Sasa ninahakikisha ninaenda kliniki ya afya ya akili mara moja kwa mwezi.
Si kwamba hali yangu ya kiakili ni mbaya sana.
Ninaenda tu kupata dawa za usingizi.
text.On nights when I cannot sleep, if I take: Usiku ninaposhindwa kulala, nikitumia dawa kutoka kliniki ya afya ya akili, ninaweza kulala fofofo.
text.Also, just the feeling of safety that \": Hata uhakika tu wa kufikiria “ninayo dawa hiyo” hunisaidia kulala, na hilo hunifurahisha pia.
text.From here on, this is a total amateur's: Kuanzia hapa, haya ni maoni ya mtu asiye na utaalamu kabisa.
text.I think a clinic with more doctors might: Nadhani unapochagua kliniki ya afya ya akili, huenda iliyo na madaktari wengi ikawa bora.
text.Clinics in Japan usually cost quite a lo: Japani, ziara ya kwanza kliniki kwa kawaida hugharimu kiasi kikubwa.
text.If you change the clinic itself, you hav: Ukibadilisha kliniki yenyewe, utalazimika kulipia ziara ya kwanza tena.
text.But if you can change your doctor inside: Lakini ukiweza kubadilisha daktari ndani ya kliniki hiyo hiyo, unaokoa pesa kidogo.
text.In a good way, it is very systematic, an: Kwa maana nzuri, mfumo wake umepangwa vizuri na kila kitu huenda kwa urahisi hadi ninapomwona daktari.
text.I think some mental health doctors suit: Nadhani baadhi ya madaktari wa afya ya akili wanafaa kwako na wengine hawakufai.
